Used as the project context of the scenario. In SPPR terms this corresponds to the owning project of the scenario.

This is a wizard default, not a list of permitted values. Shared lists are edited under Project Catalogs and Numbering and stored in .kot.
config.newScenarioDefaults.systemFunctio: Initial system functions for migration into the shared project catalog.

System functions live in the project `.kot/property-catalogs.yml`, under `systemFunctions`. Share this file through Git.

This setting only initializes a missing section. Names and UIDs are preserved; after migration, edit the project catalog through the manager or its YAML file. The first catalog entry is the default.

[Open System Functions Manager](command:kotTestToolkit.manageSystemFunctions)

config.runVanessa.vanessaEpfPath.descrip: Path to vanessa-automation.epf for built-in Vanessa launch from Test Manager (absolute or relative to workspace root).
config.runVanessa.runtimeDirectory.descr: Directory for Vanessa runtime files (scenario log/status). Absolute or relative to workspace root.
config.runVanessa.showOutputPanel.descri: Automatically show the Output panel when starting Vanessa Automation launch.
config.runVanessa.commandTemplate.descri: Shell command template for launching Vanessa Automation for a selected scenario.
config.runVanessa.commandTemplate.markdo:
Optional command template used by the run icon in Test Manager.

Available placeholders:
- `${scenarioName}` / `${scenarioNameQuoted}`
- `${featurePath}` / `${featurePathQuoted}`
- `${jsonPath}` / `${jsonPathQuoted}`
- `${workspaceRoot}` / `${workspaceRootQuoted}`

If empty, the extension uses built-in Vanessa launch logic (1C + vanessa-automation.epf + StartFeaturePlayer).
Live run log refresh interval in seconds for running scenarios.
config.runVanessa.autoDetectMinStartupUp: Minimum number of fresh run-log updates required at startup before the background Vanessa auto-detection attaches tracking.
config.runVanessa.autoDetectInactivityTi: How many seconds the auto-detected Vanessa run may stay without log updates before tracking is removed as inactive.
config.formExplorer.snapshotPath.descrip: Path to the universal Form Explorer snapshot JSON file produced by the bridge session. Absolute or relative to workspace root.
config.formExplorer.configurationSourceD: Path to the 1C configuration source directory used for static Form Explorer enrichment and source mapping. Absolute or relative to workspace root.
config.formExplorer.generatedArtifactsDi: Directory for generated Form Explorer artifacts such as snapshot sidecars, bridge files and static index. Absolute or relative to workspace root.
config.formExplorer.extensionBuildComman: Optional shell command template that overrides the built-in Windows 1C .cfe builder for the generated Form Explorer extension project.

Optional shell command template for one-click Form Explorer extension build.

If left empty on Windows, the extension uses the built-in builder with the configured `1cv8c.exe` path and sibling `1cv8.exe`: temporary file infobase -> `/LoadConfigFromFiles` for the base configuration -> `/LoadConfigFromFiles ... -Extension` for the generated project -> `/DumpCfg ... -Extension` to `.cfe`.

Available placeholders:
- `${workspaceRoot}` / `${workspaceRootQuoted}`
- `${configurationSourceDir}` / `${configurationSourceDirQuoted}`
- `${generatedArtifactsDir}` / `${generatedArtifactsDirQuoted}`
- `${extensionSourceDir}` / `${extensionSourceDirQuoted}`
- `${cfePath}` / `${cfePathQuoted}`
- `${snapshotPath}` / `${snapshotPathQuoted}`

Set this only if you want to replace the built-in builder with `oscript`, `vrunner`, custom scripts, or another 1C build pipeline.
config.formExplorer.autoRefreshSeconds.d: Refresh interval for the Form Explorer snapshot file in seconds while the panel is visible.
config.formExplorer.showOutputPanel.desc: Automatically show the Output panel when preparing and starting the Form Explorer bridge.
config.formExplorer.bridge.testClientPor: TCP port used for TestClient communication between the startup (TestManager) infobase and the target infobase. Both sides must use the same port. Default: 1538.
config.platforms.catalog.description: Catalog of available 1C platforms used by KOT launches.
config.platforms.catalog.markdownDescrip:
Catalog of available 1C platforms used by KOT launches.

Each item must contain `name` and `clientExePath` pointing to `1cv8c.exe`.

The first item in the list is treated as the default platform. KOT fills this catalog with detected installed platforms automatically; the newest detected version is placed first.

[Open Platform Manager](command:kotTestToolkit.managePlatforms)
config.platforms.promptForLaunches.descr: Ask which 1C platform to use when launching infobases, Form Explorer, or built-in Vanessa. If disabled, KOT always uses the default platform.
config.ai.apiFormat.description: HTTP API format used to call the connected LLM.
config.ai.apiFormat.responses.desc: OpenAI Responses API (`/responses`). Usually best for OpenAI cloud models.
config.ai.apiFormat.chatCompletions.desc: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API (`/chat/completions`). Best default for local providers and proxies.
config.ai.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the connected LLM API, without the final `/responses` or `/chat/completions` path.
config.ai.baseUrl.markdownDescription:
Base URL of the connected LLM API.

Local examples:
- `http://localhost:11434/v1`
- `http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1`

Cloud examples:
- `https://api.openai.com/v1`
- `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai`
config.ai.apiVersion.description: Optional API version passed as ?api-version=. Use only for endpoints requiring it. Leave empty for Azure OpenAI v1, standard OpenAI and local providers.
config.ai.apiVersion.markdownDescription:
Optional version appended as `?api-version=...` to every request URL. Use only when required by your endpoint.

Leave empty for Azure OpenAI `/openai/v1`, standard OpenAI and local providers. Dated Azure deployment endpoints have a different authentication contract; setting a version does not change KOT's Bearer header to `api-key`.
config.ai.apiKey.description: API key for the connected LLM. Stored in plain text in VS Code settings. Local servers may use any non-empty placeholder.
config.ai.apiKey.markdownDescription:
API key for the connected LLM.

This value is stored in plain text in your VS Code settings file, so use a scoped key with minimal permissions whenever possible. For local providers that ignore auth, any non-empty value such as `local` is enough.
config.ai.model.description: Model name used to generate the scenario description in KOT metadata.
config.ai.model.markdownDescription:
Model name used for scenario-description generation.

The default is a lightweight local model name for Ollama-compatible setups: `qwen3:4b`. Change it to the exact model id available in your local or cloud provider.
config.ai.outputLanguage.description: Language of the generated scenario description.
config.ai.maxLineLength.description: Maximum visible line length for generated description lines, including YAML indentation.
config.ai.timeoutSeconds.description: Timeout for AI description requests in seconds.
config.ai.systemPrompt.description: Optional custom system prompt for AI scenario description generation.
config.ai.systemPrompt.markdownDescripti:
Optional override for the built-in system prompt used when generating the scenario description in KOT metadata.

Leave empty to use the extension default prompt tailored for KOT/1C YAML scenarios.

config.projectCatalogs.title: Project catalogs and numbering
config.catalogs.projects.markdownDescrip: Projects. Edit in **Workspace** or **Folder** settings. Changes are synchronized with `.kot/property-catalogs.yml` (`projects`) and shared through Git.
config.catalogs.responsibles.markdownDes: Responsible people. Edit in **Workspace** or **Folder** settings. Shared storage: `.kot/property-catalogs.yml` (`responsibles`). This is a names catalog, without test-client credentials.
config.catalogs.reportLevel1.markdownDes: Report level 1 names. Edit in **Workspace** or **Folder** settings. Synchronized with `.kot/property-catalogs.yml` (`reportLevel1`).
config.catalogs.reportLevel2.markdownDes: Report level 2 names. Edit in **Workspace** or **Folder** settings. Synchronized with `.kot/property-catalogs.yml` (`reportLevel2`).
config.catalogs.categories.markdownDescr: Categories. Edit in **Workspace** or **Folder** settings. Synchronized with `.kot/property-catalogs.yml` (`categories`). Catalog changes do not rename existing scenario fields.
config.catalogs.systemFunctions.markdown: System functions: **name → UID**. Edit in **Workspace** or **Folder** settings. Leave the UID empty for a new function; KOT generates it and saves it in `.kot/property-catalogs.yml`. Keep existing UIDs when renaming.
config.numbering.series.markdownDescript: Tester series: **six-digit prefix → author**, for example `000012` → `Tester name`. Edit in **Workspace** or **Folder** settings. Shared storage: `.kot/test-numbering.yml`; issued counters are preserved automatically. A series with issued codes cannot be deleted.
config.numbering.prefix.markdownDescript: Preferred author series, for example `000012`. Keep personal preferences in User settings. The wizard always offers author/series selection with the current choice first; `manual` prefers manual codes. Series and authors belong to the shared project catalog. Scenario responsible is a separate field.
config.newScenarioDefaults.systemFunctio: Use Catalogs: System Functions to edit the shared project catalog. This legacy array only initializes a missing catalog.

KOT reads 1cv8.mft: .cf for empty configured infobases and configuration updates, .dt for demo infobases. ConfigurationTemplatesLocation in 1CEStart.cfg and the default template directory are also discovered. Set machine-specific paths in User settings.

config.vanessaControl.formCompletions.de: Read the current connected test client form for editor IntelliSense even when Form Explorer is closed.
